messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-21T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: [Action] Pipe-to-Goal sprint brief: stage updates & micro-commit plan

Team / Elaine —

Quick morning check: finance ran a condensed run-rate and we’re looking at a ~22% shortfall vs. target if no additional committed ACV moves this week. I attached a scratch workbook with the micro-scenarios (pipe-to-goal-scratch.xlsx).

Asks:
- Internal owners: please update stage and probability for any opportunities you own that are in negotiation/legal by EOD tomorrow (11/22). We’ll lock probabilities for the forecast close next week.
- Elaine: any change to ACME’s procurement timing or exec approval this week? Even a tentative close window helps the model.

Specific note on ACME (DEAL-7182): list price stands; procurement said legal review, no PO yet. If you can share a target signature date, we can move the opportunity probability.

Thanks — short bullets appreciated.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Sr. Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Park <elaine@acme.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: [Action] Pipe-to-Goal sprint brief: stage updates & micro-commit plan

Aditya —

Thanks for the note. Quick update from our side: procurement has the redline and legal is scheduled to review on 11/24. Our month-end approval meeting is 11/30, but that is still a soft target. I can push for an earlier attention from procurement if Redwood can provide a final one-page SOW and a short risk summary by EOD 11/22.

If that helps, we’d aim for a tentative signature window of 11/29–12/03, subject to legal comments.

—Elaine
Elaine Park
Sr. IT Procurement
Acme Enterprises

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: [Action] Pipe-to-Goal sprint brief: stage updates & micro-commit plan

Thanks Elaine — helpful.

Marshaling next steps:
- Marissa will own moving ACME to "Negotiation — Legal Review" stage and set probability to 60% until countersign (we'll review if legal asks are material).
- Aditya/Marissa: I’ll draft the one-pager + 3-line risk summary and drop it here by EOD 11/22. Elaine, if there are specific callouts procurement wants included, ping me directly.
- Internal owners (thread): please do the EOD stage/probability updates Aditya requested. Use the tab labelled "Sprint updates" in the attached workbook — one row per opp.

Quick micro-commit plan: if we can convert 2 of the 5 targeted mid-market opps in the next 10 days (ACV > $50k each), we reduce the gap materially. I’ll coordinate a focused outreach cadence after EOD tom.

On quoting: keep list prices; we can suggest a time-limited discount for bundling but want to preserve ACV.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Manager, Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference
